limitations: Regular simplex under normalized Hausdorff facet measure, or arbitrary simplex with normalized equal-facet sampling.
Only affine degree-one real L2 projection, integer dimension at least two.
No claims about general polytope boundary measure or global finite-element coupling.
Unindexed equivalent formula cannot be ruled out.
scientific_integrity: Same-model proof and arithmetic review only; no independent scientific validation. Formulas supported by analytical derivation and reproducible exact checks.
title: Exact boundary-simplex affine projection norm and its surface-volume stability gap
